verdict.rationale: Controlling whether conversations are used for model training is a fair question for an AI assistant like Kimi, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents a training opt-out, a data-usage setting, or a privacy control for conversations. Memory, audit logs and API key management are different features and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can control whether my conversations are used to train models
